players.name: Carl Granderson
players.comment: Granderson recorded seven tackles (five solo), including 2.0 sacks, and one pass defense during the Saints' 23-22 overtime win over the Browns in Week 9.

players.name: Kaden Elliss
players.comment: Elliss recorded 11 tackles (eight solo), including 1.0 sacks, during the Saints' 23-22 overtime victory over the Browns in Week 9.

players.name: Pete Werner
players.comment: Werner registered 11 tackles (three solo) during the Saints' 23-22 overtime win over the Browns in Week 9.

players.name: Martin Emerson Jr.
players.comment: Emerson (shin) is active for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

players.name: Charlie Smyth
players.comment: The Saints elevated Smyth from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.comment: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that Tyson should get "a healthy dose more" of snaps in Sunday's game against the Panthers, Jeff Nowak of WWL Radio reports.

players.name: Devaughn Vele
players.comment: Vele caught two passes for 17 yards on four targets in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over the Browns.

players.name: Kelvin Banks Jr.
players.comment: Banks (ankle) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Ross Jackson of WWL-TV reports.

players.name: David Edwards
players.comment: Edwards (knee) does not have an injury designation against the Panthers on Sunday, Ross Jackson of WWL-TV reports.

players.name: Erik McCoy
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Taliese Fuaga
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.comment: Etienne (hamstring) is active for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

players.name: Devin Lloyd
players.comment: Lloyd posted eight tackles (five solo) and one pass defense during the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.

players.name: Bobby Okereke
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Jaelan Phillips
players.comment: Phillips (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, is in line to play, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Will Lee III
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Ryan Fitzgerald
players.comment: Fitzgerald missed his only field-goal attempt and went 3-for-3 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

players.name: Tetairoa McMillan
players.comment: McMillan caught four of six targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.comment: Coker caught four of five targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

players.name: Xavier Legette
players.comment: Legette (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Saints, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.

players.name: Damien Lewis
players.comment: Lewis (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.

players.name: Bryce Young
players.comment: Young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos. He added 13 yards on his only carry and lost a fumble.

players.name: Tommy Tremble
players.comment: Tremble caught four of six targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

players.name: Chuba Hubbard
players.comment: Hubbard carried the ball 16 times for 79 yards and caught four of five targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 26-21 loss to Denver.
